articleTitle: Construction of a digital twin model for ships based on BeiDou communication
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to reduce the limitation of geographical area and network bandwidth on building real-time ship twin vision model, realize the construction of ship digital twin vision in full time and spatial domain, and improve the stability and safety of ship remote monitoring, this paper develops a construction method to build the ship digital twin vision through the Cesium framework with BeiDou satellite communication as the communication medium. The dynamic information such as ship position are first and image collected from the ship side.Then, the extended Kalman filter, Huffman algorithm, and LZW algorithm are used for noise reduction and lossless compression of the ship data. The data is send to the shore side serve via BeiDou satellie After that and using Mercator projection in the Cesium framework is deployed to realise the ship digital twin system. By extending the Kalman filter model to simulate the ship trajectory and comparing it with the twin vision built through 5G mobile network, the proposed technique is verified to be able to build a ship digital twin vision system more accurately by transmitting the ship’s dynamic information through BeiDou in the region without network signal.

articleTitle: α-In2Se3/MoS2 Ferroelectric Tunnel Junctions Based on van der Waals Heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Ferroelectric tunnel junction is a promising candidate for emerging memory devices owing to its low-power consumption, nonvolatility and non-destructive read-out. A ferroelectric tunnel junction is a two-terminal device consisting of an ultra-thin ferroelectric layer sandwiched between two metal electrodes, and the tunnelling barrier can be modified by the ferroelectric polarization reversal, resulting in its tunnelling electroresistance (TER). Here, we demonstrate ferroelectric tunnel junctions that use α-In2Se3 as the ferroelectric barrier, and MoS2 and Ti/Au as asymmetric contacts. The tunnelling barrier can be modified effectively by the reversal of α-In2Se3 ferroelectric polarization, which results in a TER greater than 10<sup>4</sup> at room temperature. Our results suggest that Van der Waals α-In2Se3/MoS2 ferroelectric tunnel junctions can be a suitable candidate for the future memory applications.

articleTitle: Rail Track Area Environment Perception Based on Rader Target Gird
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the improvement of rail transportation automation level, obstacle detection technology gradually becomes a key technology for trains to realize unmanned driving in a complex environment. Traditional obstacle detection efficiency is low and labor-intensive; existing in-vehicle sensor obstacle detection limited by the work characteristics of different sensors have low detection rates and false alarms in the detection process. In this paper, we propose a target grid-based method for radar to sense the environment in the track area. We fuse millimeter wave radar and LIDAR two-source data and combine them with target grid algorithms to achieve environment sensing and obstacle detection in rail transit track areas. The relevant experiments show that the target grid-based environment sensing method for radar track area proposed in this paper effectively removes the flash-out noise, improves the accuracy of the information obtained by millimeter wave radar, and has a false alarm rate of 0.3% and a target detection rate of more than 99.2%, in a multi-noise target scenario, providing a reference for researchers in related fields.

articleTitle: FE-YOLO: An Efficient and Lightweight Feature-Enhanced Fire Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The detection and location of fires are critical to forest safety. Timely detection of fires can effectively control natural disasters and maintain the stability of the ecosystem. The flame and smoke in the early stage of forest fires have the characteristics of small targets, and the transparent smoke makes the details of the marks unclear, which poses a significant challenge for the fire detection task. To solve the above problems, we propose a feature-enhanced network architecture based on the YOLO-v5s network for efficient multi-scale object detection, named FE-YOLO. Specifically, based on YOLO-v5s, we added the Mixup data enhancement strategy to solve the problem of blurred target boundaries. To further improve our proposed model, we offer a new feature pyramid module that can reuse features from previous layers to enhance image feature extraction. We evaluate the proposed method on homemade fire images, on which FEYOLO performs well. The mAP result of FE-YOLO is 72.53%. Compared with the baseline network YOLO-v5s, it has been improved by 3.42%, which can be used to detect forest fires quickly.

articleTitle: Using gated clock in ASIC design
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This article mainly discusses the implementation of gated clock technology, and expounds how the gated clock affects the following stage: logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), automatic test pattern generation (ATPG), clock tree synthesis (CTS) and standard cell library design.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Intelligent Information Network system in Library
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to continuously explore the construction content of intelligent library and improve the level of literature information resources guarantee of library, this paper takes the library of Dalian Naval Academy as an example, analyzes the present situation of the construction of information network system of military school library, and sums up some problems, such as backward business management system, imperfect service function of digital book management and service platform, incomplete construction of intelligent book management system, and so on. In view of the above problems, this paper puts forward that the military school library should constantly strengthen the construction of hardware and software, improve the level of intelligent service and management of the library, and constantly promote the process of the construction of the intelligent library.

articleTitle: Development and application of intelligent home control system based on TRIZ theory in single live wire environment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Based on TRIZ theory, this paper addresses the problem that the smart home products do not work in the case of single live wire. By analyzing the problem, applying tools such as little creature method, object-field model, technical contradiction, functional tailoring and knowledge base to get a technical solution to the problem, and evaluating the solution to get the optimal solution, we finally design a smart home control system that can work in the single live wire environment. The smart home product can be used in a single live wire environment, and it is convenient to replace the old product in place only.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network with Residual Skip Connections for Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: When using orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) for communication in channels with high resistance to inter-symbol interference (ISI), conventional channel estimation methods and neural networks with few layers perform poorly. To address this issue, the residual channel estimation network (ResCENet) is a deep neural network (DNN) containing residual skip connections that is suggested for channel estimation. ResCENet differs from previously investigated simple DNNs in that it is deeper and capable of detecting the link in sequential OFDM symbols, as well as performing estimation and demodulation tasks end-to-end. Specifically, ResCENet consists of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), bidirectional recurrent neural networks (Bi-RNNs), fully connected neural networks (FCNNs). To prevent the degradation problem caused by too many layers, residual skip connections were added, which can increase the number of layers in DNNs. Some regularization measures were also added. ResCENet receives a complex number-based digital signal and can directly restore the transmitted digital symbols. The simulation results show that ResCENet can achieve excellent channel estimation with only 4 out of 64 symbols as pilots, outperforming the conventional methods, as well as simple FCNNs.

articleTitle: Research on Access Control Model of Zero Trust Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of cloud service and network architecture, the boundaries of enterprises are disappearing. The traditional network defense architecture that relies on implicit trust is no longer suitable for network security situations. To deal with more and more complicated network status, zero trust technology and data analysis such as k-means clustering algorithm have been cited in network security defense. This paper investigates an access control model based on zero trust technology and k-means algorithm to ensure that legal users can access privilege application. We consider the scenario where remote users connect zero trust networks by personal computer without unified authentication.

articleTitle: Intelligent detection method of rail transit abnormal events based on multi-scale computing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In recent years, public events have occurred in public places in the field of rail transit, which has aroused social concern. As a typical public emergency, human body falls on platforms and other places is the biggest safety hazard. The detection of abnormal human behavior in the abnormal events of rail transit is an important part. Among them, the skeleton extraction technology of human 3D point clouds under the condition of limited resources is the basis and difficulty of point cloud technology research. In the process of exploring and developing new methods, this thesis has programmed them and analyzed and evaluated their results.

articleTitle: A De-embedding Method for Accurately Characterizing the Dielectric Property of Biological Liquids
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: An inexpensive calibration method is designed for accurate liquid characterization for biological and medical applications. Compared to the traditional two-step calibration procedure, the proposed method is more flexible and user-friendly. The calibration and de-embedding standards can be flexibly designed based on the structure of the test fixture and the sensor where the liquid under test (LUT) is contained. Additionally, a single sensor can be used by using different liquids with known dielectric property for the calibration and de-embedding process. The verification procedure with measurement and simulation results has successfully demonstrated the reliability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Doppler ambiguity number estimation based on range walk
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The range walk slope is obtained by two-dimensional search using radon transform, but this method has the problems of large amount of search operation and low accuracy of radial velocity estimation. Therefore, based on the traditional single channel method, this chapter uses the range walk information to estimate the Doppler ambiguity number. Firstly, the matched filter method is used to correct the range bending and retain the range walking information of the moving target. Then, aiming at the problem of large amount of two-dimensional search in radon transform, using the idea of Doppler fuzzy number prior knowledge table, the two-dimensional search in radon transform is transformed into the calculation of several angle Radon transform values, so the amount of calculation is greatly reduced. Finally, the experimental simulation is carried out. The experimental results show that the algorithm studied in this chapter can accurately and quickly estimate the Doppler ambiguity number.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Signcryption Scheme with Equality Test from CLC to PKI for Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In recent years, a lot of research has been carried out on the privacy protection of heterogeneous Internet of Vehicles (IoV). However, cloud servers in the IoV store a large amount of ciphertext data, so how to efficiently search ciphertext data encrypted by different public keys is also an urgent problem to be solved. This paper proposes a heterogeneous signcryption scheme with equality test from CLC to PKI (CPHS-ET) for the complex IoV environment. It allows roadside units to encrypt sensitive data in the CLC cryptosystem, which is then sent to the vehicle in the PKI cryptosystem and uploaded to the cloud server at the same time. Further, the cloud server can perform equality tests on different ciphertexts. In the random oracle model, our designed CPHS-ET is proved to satisfy confidentiality, unforgeability, one-way. Performance analysis shows that our CPHS-ET scheme is more efficient.

articleTitle: Aperture Coupled Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Miniaturized Metal-mountable UHF RFID tag
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: UHF RFID tags for industrial applications requires tags to be metal-mountable, small and having long operational/reading range. Most tag design approaches have to compromise between size and operational range or bandwidth. In this paper, an aperture coupled cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna(DRA) for miniaturized metal-mountable UHF RFID tag has been presented. A wideband, long range miniaturized metal-mountable UHF RFID tag is realized by firstly utilizing the small form factor of a HE<inf>11δ</inf> mode dielectric resonator. And sencondly, by taking advantage of the symmetricity of the balanced port in a RFID chip, a novel compact feeding structure was proposed to further reduce the size. Antenna characteristics and its feeding structure have been studied by fullwave simulation, and prototypes have been fabricated and tested. The proposed antenna design resulted in a UHF RFID tag with overall size of only Φ27.4mm*14mm. Its reading range is from 4m to 12m depending on the size of metal surface on which the tag has been mounted. And the measured reading range bandwidth of the prototype is 40MHz. Although it is small in size, it presented a wide bandwidth to cover both Chinese and North American bands.

articleTitle: A Low-Power-Consumption FBG Sensor Interrogator
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power-consumption fiber grating interrogation system based on Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser (VCSEL). The system exhibits a 3.5 nm tuning range and less than 100 mW power consumption. The advantages of the temperature-free VCSEL interrogation system are fully utilized to form a separate, low-power, miniaturized FBG sensing interrogation system with Wireless sensor network sensor nodes.The practicability and validity of the system are verified by the experimental results of temperature monitoring. It is an effective solution for applications involving few and concentrated monitoring points of temperature and stress.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of MobileNet neural network acceleration system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low computational efficiency when convolutional neural network is deployed in embedded devices, this work proposes a convolution neural network acceleration architecture based on FPGA, and designs and implements a MobileNet neural network acceleration system based on FPGA. Firstly, the method of dynamic fixed-point quantization and operator fusion is designed to optimize the model. Secondly, the method of convolution block, parallel convolution calculation and data stream optimization is designed based on FPGA to improve the efficiency of convolution operation and system throughput. The system is tested on Xilinx PYNQ-Z2 platform. The average frame rate of the system is 6 fps and the power consumption is 2.45w. The system has the characteristics of low power consumption and low delay, which can effectively improve the operation efficiency of convolutional neural network algorithm in embedded devices.

articleTitle: A Secure Data Offloading Strategy for UAV Wireless Networks Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The application of the concept of edge computing is inseparable from computational offloading technology, which is used to offload computational tasks generated by user end devices to a place with superior computing power and return the computational results to the local area, thus reducing the loss of local resources to a large extent. The objective of this paper is to investigate a secure data offloading strategy for UAV wireless networks based on an improved ant colony algorithm. The improved ant colony algorithm is used as a decision algorithm to implement a single offload for multiple tasks with the help of Matlab, and a continuous offload simulation system for multiple tasks and its visualisation is implemented with the help of techniques such as containers. Through controlled experiments, the effects of selection and variation behaviour on the performance of the algorithm are analysed, and the performance and benefits of the improved ant colony algorithm are analysed with reference to the genetic algorithm. Based on the experimental data, it can be seen that the improved ant colony algorithm performs better and its benefits gradually increase as the system runs.

articleTitle: Campus Wireless Access Point Anomaly Detection using Unsupervised Method at Multiple Time Granularities
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As wireless networks play an increasingly important role in campus communications, identifying anomalous APs(wireless access points) is becoming increasingly important. This paper proposes an unsupervised AP anomaly detection method at multiple time granularities, which does not depend on the labeling quality of training samples. In addition, the proposed method considers the APs’ behavior under different time granularities and can eliminate the influence of improper selection of the time granularity on anomaly detection. Experimental results show that the proposed method can detect anomalous APs and help network administrators locate wireless network problems.

articleTitle: Application of efficient display technology of picture component based on new generation dispatching support system
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of station area graphic display of traditional distribution network system, this paper proposes an efficient display technology of picture component based on new generation dispatch support system, and gives specific solutions to key technologies such as picture component generation, picture component display, automatic generation of sub-scene instance, fusion display of grid graphics and component, etc. This technology has been applied in provincial electric power company in China. Practice shows that this technology can achieve the goal of efficient display of picture component on the basis of new generation dispatching support system, and improve the efficiency of graphics display.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Calibration in Lightweight Vector Impedance Measurement Module
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With designs of a calibration and error correction system for the lightweight vector impedance measurement module, this paper presents the devising framework of the software and hardware of the system, deduces the mathematical principle of the impedance error correction, and completes the experimental verification of the system while for the engineering application of the vector impedance measurement module, the engineering solution of the calibration and error correction system is constructed with tests and solutions for the systematic errors caused by changes in ambient temperature. Being small in size, good in scalability, fast in test speed and high in efficiency, the designed hardware can be extended to an embedded measurement system, which can be utilized with a modular vector impedance measurement system.

articleTitle: General Array Optimization Strategy for Noncircular Sources with the Minimum Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, an array optimization strategy for noncircular sources is put forward, which works with any type of antenna array. Firstly, the array manifold is expended based on the noncircular characteristic and the virtual array is enhanced using sum and difference coarray (SDCA). Then the equivalence of symmetrical positions in the SDCA is fully exploited to transform the original array to a sparser form. Quantitative analysis and experimental simulation reveal the validity of the presented strategy in terms of minimizing the mutual coupling and improving the performance of direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation.

articleTitle: Comparison of Techniques with Speech Enhancement and Nonlinear Rectification for Robust Speaker Identificatio
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Automatic speaker recognition is about the identification of a person based on his or her characteristic voice with the help of machines. However, this identification is drastically degraded due to adverse conditions. Our aim of this study is to evaluate the performance of the techniques Power- Normalized Cepstral Coefficients (PNCC) and Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) on NIST 2002 database, as well as using Wavelet Denoising and Cubic Law as techniques to speech enhancement and nonlinear rectification to improve speaker recognition rates. Results showed that combined Wavelet Denoising and Cubic Law get improved the recognition rates under noisy conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Government Countermeasure Optimization of Multi - Agent Complex Network Game in Intelligent Vehicle Cooperative Manufacturing Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to explore the influence of different policies on the development of different types of automobile enterprises under the background of decreasing carbon emission, this study uses the NetLogo to construct a three-party cooperative game network model for technology enterprises, traditional car enterprises and new forces of automobile manufacturing, and uses big data technologies to obtain the attributes of enterprises and establish the initial network. Analyzing the strategy selections and development influencing factors of three types of agents in intelligent automobile research and development cooperation according to the process and result of multi-agent complex network game. The study found that when the government encourages the purchase of standard models and builds a carbon trading market, the running situation of tripartite cooperative game network is significantly better than the government does not intervene, which means the strategic choice and development of the three parties will be affected by the policy, and the greater intensity for encouraging the purchase of standard models, the more benefits traditional car companies can get; the more complete the carbon trading market is, the greater advantage of the new forces will have. The two policies only affect whether technology enterprises will participate in the game, the final number of participating technology enterprises always tend to stabilize.

articleTitle: Judgment method of subway carriage clearance based on gridded difference image
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the increase of railway mileage and people’s travel demand, the passenger volume of rail transit is growing year by year. In the context of the rail transit informatization, real-time monitoring of passenger behavior is not only conducive to enhance the operational efficiency and ensuring the safety of people’s lives and property, but also of great significance to improving the ability of rail companies to solve emergencies. In the case of normal train operation or emergency, carriage clearance and personnel evacuation are essential and important processes. However, at present, the judgment of carriage clearance in subway is still done by manual, which is inefficient and unable to adapt to the intelligent development. Due to the limited hardware support equipment that the train can carry, it is difficult for current mainstream deep learning methods to utilize low resources for distributed deployment in the face of synchronous video monitoring of multiple carriages. In view of the above, we propose a gridded image difference method, which combines background subtraction and temporal difference, and further reduces the complexity of the algorithm by dividing the region of interest. Applying this method, we can make real-time judgment of people and objects detained in the carriage, and provide an effective solution for intelligent carriage clearance.

articleTitle: 5G Antenna Based on Metal Mesh Film Material Design and Application
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G network and the breakthrough of new materials, various of new antennas have been developed. The transparent antenna, which based on optically transparent materials, is highly transmittance to visible light. It overcomes the limitations of conventional antenna installation, highly harmonious with the environment, and achieves the antenna transparency effect, has a wide range of application prospects. This paper expounds transparent antenna applied in different application fields and introduces antenna design, test as well as verification.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation of communication system based on comprehensive assessment measure in electromagnetic warfare
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: To evaluate the power of communication systems, a model based on comprehensive measure is proposed. The efficiency of the communication system is first coarse clustered, and then the mathematical model about the comprehensively measure of the system efficiency is established based on the comprehensive measurement is realized. Finally, the efficiency of the three communication systems is evaluated by simulation to verify the feasibility and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Attack Graph Node Risk Probability Calculation For Level Systems Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: It is an effective method to implement risk assessment of level information systems interconnection using attack graph. However, correlation between nodes in the attack graph is very complex. For example, a node may be provided by a number of its predecessor nodes together, and these predecessor nodes are influenced by other nodes. Thus, It is not independent between these pre-nodes. For this correlation, the previous researches or assume the pre-nodes are independent of each other, or have the node of the largest risk probability to represent these pre-nodes. These studies didn’t actually handle such correlation in attack graphs objectively and correctly, which may lead to calculation error and affecting the final outcome of the risk assessment. To solve this problem, this article combines nodes risk probability calculation with CVSS, and correctly handles the node correlation with the use of Bayesian Networks-based directed-separation (D-separation) theorem. What’s more, A algorithm combining Accurate calculation and approximate calculation is proposed, which can reduce the running time and increase efficiency. The correction and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by related experiments. Compared with the previous studies, this method have a better applicability in complex attack graphs.

articleTitle: Steepness Improvement of HTS Wideband Bandpass Filter at Low Frequency End
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: A low order wideband bandpass filter is designed onto the substrate coated with high temperature superconducting (HTS) films on both sides by means of an equivalent model of an interdigital capacitor. In the designed filter, its upper and lower cut-off frequencies can be separately adjusted, and the return loss (RL) in its passband can also be reduced by adjusting the interdigital capacitance. Owing to the low order feature of the designed filter, its edge steepness at the low frequency end is very poor. To improve its edge steepness at the low frequency end, a series resonator is connected with the input end of the filter in parallel to generate a transmission zero. Simulation results prove that the proposed approach can apparently improve the edge steepness of the filter at the low frequency end. All these results demonstrate that the proposed combination design scheme is feasible and suitable to improve the single end edge steepness of the low order bandpass filter.

articleTitle: SNGN:Similar Neighbors Graph Transition Network for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The target of session-based recommendation is to predict the next item to be clicked by the user based on anonymous sequences. The current mainstream session recommendation model is to build the session into a graph to capture item transitions within it. However, this only gives information about the current session, ignoring complex project information in other sessions. If other sessions are blindly added to the model, noise may be introduced, so we propose a new method to calculate adjacent sessions. In this paper, we propose a novel method, namely a similar neighbors Graph Transition Network for Session-based Recommendation (SNGN), to model item transitions within not only the current session but also the neighbor sessions. Specifically, first, we get the neighbor session graph through our new neighbor session computing method. Then input the current session graph and neighbor session graph into the perceptron to get the corresponding representation. Finally, the two representations are fused to obtain the user preference representation. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that SNGN outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A method for improving the sensitivity of UV communication machine on Pico-Nano-Satellites
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The UV band unintentional radiation emission by Pico-/Nano-satellite-borne electronic equipment is mostly strong, which easily interferes the satellite-based UV communications and hence causes a sharp decline of the sensitivity performance. In this study, a method for improving the sensitivity of Pinar satellite in UV communication is proposed. Firstly, the process and method of detecting the interference in the UV band of Pinar satellite are designed. After testing and analyzing, the interfering source could be detected and the corresponding interfering transmission path could be determined. Then, according to the characteristics of different interfering sources, the corresponding rectification measures are put forward, and the effectiveness of rectification measures is evaluated in advance before the rectification measures are implemented by means of electromagnetic simulation. Finally, the whole star test is performed to verify the rectification effect. By utilizing this method, the unintentional UV radiation interference of the electronic devices on the satellite is greatly weakened, and the star-mounting sensitivity of the UV communication machine is improved.

articleTitle: • Research on vector data encryption method based on SM4 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, it is easier to obtain vector data, and it is necessary to ensure the security of data storage and transmission. This paper presents a method of vector data coordinate encryption in Shapefile format using domestic password SM4 algorithm, which can ensure data security without changing the vector data structure. The system clock is used as the random seed to generate the encryption key, and the coordinate sequence of each element of vector data is read. Firstly, the coordinates are preprocessed according to the ID of the element, and then the encryption key is used to encrypt the coordinate information to obtain the ciphertext data. The experiments verify the feasibility of the domestic cipher SM4 algorithm to encrypt vector data. The encryption efficiency can reach 90M/S, and the decryption efficiency can reach 92MB/S. The encryption method can protect the storage security of vector data, improve the theoretical system of vector data encryption, and has certain research significance.

articleTitle: Network Transport Layer Experiment Design Based on Online Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Through three years’ teaching practice, our teaching group found that the current computer network experimental teaching cannot well complete the training objectives of curriculum. Based on the CS144 course experiment of Stanford University, our teaching group has carried out an improved design. The improvements include the online experiment platform, the addition of a comprehensive experiment component, and the enrichment of the testcase framework. We have deployed the improved network transport layer experiments in the spring semester of 2022. The teaching results show that the improved network transport layer experiments takes the lead and improves the innovative and challenging degree of network practice. The improved experiment solves the problems of lack of pratice for students and lack of difficulty in practice. The improved experiment allows students to master the principles of the TCP protocol and apply what they have learned in their future work, and some students have stimulated their interest in scientific research and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Risk analysis of ship collision in complex waterway system based on AIS data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Research on risk analysis of ship collisions in complex waterway systems is a challenging problem due to its randomness and complexity, which needs to be analyzed by AIS data. However, the massive AIS raw data increase the computational complexity and thus needs to be simplified. This study introduced the EPP algorithm to solve the ship collision risk analysis problem. First of all, the geographical location where the ship took the steering operation is extracted by identifying the navigation characteristics of ships in complex waterway systems. Then, the speed distribution of ships in the complex waterway system is analyzed. By combining the analysis results, the position with large collision risk in complex waterway systems is determined, which can provide a theoretical basis for port operators to set key monitoring areas in complex waterway systems.

articleTitle: A Short-time Burst Signal Detection Method Based on Cumulative Autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the innovation of network communication technology, short-time burst communication has been developed in time compression technology to a certain extent, which brings great challenges to blind signal receiving technology. However, in the blind reception of non-cooperative signals, signal time domain detection is the prerequisite and key of signal modulation parameter estimation, signal demodulation, decoding, interpretation, information acquisition and interference guidance. Therefore, under the condition of low SNR and short burst time, it is of great significance to study signal time domain detection method for blind signal reception. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a double sliding window detection algorithm based on cumulative autocorrelation. When the SNR is higher than 5dB, the detection accuracy of the algorithm can reach 90%.

articleTitle: Convolutional neural network channel pruning based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks use convolution as a special operation to achieve powerful inference by fitting a large number of parameters to the result. However, the sheer number of parameters does not allow us to fully understand how the network works, and research on network tailoring has been emerging in recent years to understand the exact mechanics of network operation. In this paper, by introducing the attention mechanism SEBlock in the Imagenet 2017 champion network SEnet, we find out the preference for input channels in the attention mechanism and propose a corresponding channel evaluation mechanism based on this preference to achieve the goal of allowing convolutional neural networks to perform on-channel pruning operations on the network while getting the performance improvement brought by the attention mechanism. In the CIFAR-10 task, the VGG16 network was able to outperform the original network by only 0.02% after 20% cut, and the Resnet family of networks was able to outperform the original network even with a 10% cut.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Panoramic Spectrum Monitoring Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: For panoramic spectrum monitoring, the traditional 50 percent overlapping sub-filter channelization structure has the problem of high complexity and high hardware resource consumption. Focusing on this, we exploit the complementary characteristics of the transition band of sub-filters and propose a 25 percent overlapping channelization structure. By doing so, it can reduce the number of sub-filters and hardware resource consumption considerably. The simulation results show that the proposed structure can also successfully reconstruct the non-aliasing and non-blind zone spectrum as the traditional one does, and saves about 30 percent of the resource consumption.

articleTitle: Visualization Research of Big Data in Higher Education Based on the Web of Science
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing, big data of higher education has received a lot of attention. This article uses the visual software Citespace from 2013 to 2022 to research higher education in big data in the Web of Science database. Through visual analysis, and uses of the keyword co-occurrence function and cluster analysis function, this article clarifies the main research directions, key documents, hotspots, and limitations in the field of big data in higher education, education big data technology, learning behavior analysis, learning style exploration, education resource management, and personalized teaching reform are the development direction and research hotspots. This article can provide readers and other researchers with some references and help.

articleTitle: UWB Channel Model Measurements and Simulation in Vehicular Passenger Compartment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Vehicle wireless signal transceiver system has attracted startlingly extensive attention worldwide with great demands of high transmission rate, high precision and high security, where ultra-wideband (UWB) has a satisfying talent to meet these requirements. Channel modelling of diverse parts in a vehicle under different circumstances is indispensable to design wireless sensor system with stringent specification. In this paper, we extract various parameters for path loss model as well as the multi path delay model from the analysis after pretreatment of the frequency-domain signal collected from a vector network analyzer (VNA) with the frequency band from 2.5 GHz to 5 GHz. When establishing the experimental platform, we selected 16 signal transmission points with corresponding application value in the passenger compartment. During the measurements and analysis, we consider and compare the effects of no-load and full-load conditions on the extracted parameters. Also, it illustrates great correlation between the model generated form the vehicular passenger compartment and the model in the industrial scene defined in IEEE 802.15.4a.

articleTitle: CIM/G-based pre-detection technology of power system graphical human-computer interaction script
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Power grid dispatching and control system adopts CIM/G language to describe the human-computer interaction interface. With the development of a new generation of control systems, CIM/G language extension supports human-computer interaction scripts for human-computer interaction requirements of various complex business scenarios. Human-computer interaction scripts bring problems of writing and testing, which affect the development efficiency and picture quality. In this paper, we propose a CIM/G-based pre-detection technology of power system graphical human-computer interaction script, which pre-detects the script in the script writing stage, effectively reduces various problems when the scripts are running, and improves the application development efficiency.

Author Keywords: new genneration dispathcing and control system

articleTitle: An identification method for threat intelligence in the security field
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Nowadays, the Internet has penetrated into all aspects of people's lives, and cyber security, as a barrier to the Internet, is becoming more and more important. Threat intelligence, as an extremely important part of cyber security, has become a research hotspot in terms of how to efficiently and quickly extract the various information it contains. Few existing research methods focus on augmented word features. To better extract the various types of entity information contained in threat intelligence, a new recognition method (RCB) is proposed in this paper. The four layers of the pre-trained model that are excellent for the text task are selected in the encoding module, and then the semantic matrix is generated by stacking these four layers vertically, and then a new semantic convolution method is proposed on this basis to convolve the semantic matrix and thus enhance the word features in a deeper way. Finally, the named entity recognition model proposed in this paper is compared with other mainstream neural network models on a threat intelligence dataset, and experiments prove that the model proposed in this paper has better results.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game study on manufacturing capacity Sharing based on block chain
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to study the behavior of manufacturing capacity sharing in the context of blockchain and promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry, a new model of manufacturing capacity sharing is constructed. Combined with evolutionary game theory, the game model of manufacturing capacity sharing behavior is constructed and simulated with MATLAB software. The results show that the game behaviors of two parties are affected by different factors, and the direct benefit coefficient, synergistic benefit coefficient, trust loss coefficient, platform incentive coefficient and blockchain platform penalty cost have positive effects on interenterprise capacity sharing; while the direct cost coefficient and sunk cost coefficient have negative effects on interenterprise capacity sharing.

articleTitle: Attribute-based searchable encryption with delegated equality test in cloud-assisted Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the popularity of cloud-assisted Internet of Things, many industries need to upload a large amount of data to cloud servers. In this paper, we combine the ideas of PE-ET and CP-ABE to propose an attribute-based equivalent testing model (ABE-ET), which can realize the outsourcing data and search. We allow the cloud server to perform equivalent testing on the ciphertext to judge whether the encrypted ciphertext of two different owners is consistent, and determine if the data owners have the same identity. During the search and equivalent-test of ciphertext, the cloud server cannot obtain any encrypted message. In the security and performance analysis, we prove that this scheme is under the adaptive chosen ciphertext attacks (CCA2) security, and it is suitable for cloud-assisted Internet environment the efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Pulse Shaping using Reflective Boundary Conditions to Mitigate Inter Symbol Interference in Molecular Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper we propose a pulse shaping technique that manipulates the boundary conditions of molecular communication channels to mitigate the inter symbol interference. The one dimensional channel impulse response used to define the pulse shaping methodology proposed is modeled using nonlinear curve fitting methods with respect to the key molecular communication channel parameters of drift velocity, diffusion coefficient, and distance between the transmitter and receiver. This paper will show that the fit performs well across a wide range of each channel parameter. Additionally, the performance of the proposed pulse shaping method is assessed using two separate metrics, the interference to total received molecule ratio and the molecular eye diagram. Both performance indicators highlight the advantages of our pulse shaping technique when compared to the conventional molecular pulse shapes used in the literature, which are based on an analytical model.

articleTitle: Low-power design in PCIe switch PHY
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Nowadays PCIe has become one of the most common used high speed data bus, and the power consumption management has drawn more and more concern. In this article we introduce device power management states and link power management states in PCIe specification, and also the actions have been taken in these states for energy conservation, especially in PCIe PHY. We provide the implementation of PHY power management in PCIe switch chip design by our company, which complies with PCIe protocol and efficient. Power consumptions in these low-power states are given out by software simulation, which prove obvious effects in power saving.

Author Keywords: Keywords- PCIe PHY; power management; low power consumption; PCIe switch

articleTitle: RLWE-based Privacy-Preserving Data Sharing Scheme for Internet of Medical Things System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) system is a collection of devices and software which are applied in medical care domains. In a IoMT system, patients and doctors conduct remote diagnosis and treatment through a health data sharing scheme. These data sharing schemes faces privacy challenges if the medical information gets leaked. However, the existing privacy-preserving data sharing schemes usually use classical encryption/signature algorithm, which will turn to be not secure under the development of quantum computer. In this paper, we propose a privacy-preserving data sharing scheme using lattice-based cryptography, the ring learning with errors (RLWE) cryptography. Our scheme integrates both quantum-resistant encryption and digital signature algorithm based on RLWE, in order to realize the resistance to quantum attack for the whole life cycle of data. In addition, the performance evaluation shows that the proposed scheme gets 75.7% higher efficiency than the existing schemes.

articleTitle: An Indoor Air Quality Detection and Alarm System Based on Micro Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: This paper designs and implements the indoor air quality detection and alarm system based on a micro control unit. Firstly, the overall design of the indoor air quality detection and alarm system is introduced. Secondly, the hardware design of the system is analyzed, including the selection of hardware modules and circuit layout for each component. Then, the system's software design process is researched. Finally, the system is experimentally tested and the error is investigated. The measured results show that the proposed indoor air quality detection and alarm system can detect and warn the indoor air quality, which has a wide range of application values.

articleTitle: A Multi-target Underwater Acoustic Signals Denoising Method Based on Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The actual underwater acoustic signals consist of multiple components such as ship-radiated noise and ambient sea noise. However, existing noise reduction methods are not effective for multi-target underwater acoustic signals. Aiming at this issue, an improved method which is based on wavelet threshold denoising is proposed. First of all, to obtain the wavelet coefficients, the original signal is decomposed using wavelet. After that, on account of the shortcomings of the traditional wavelet threshold denoising, an improvement way to calculate the threshold and a new wavelet threshold function are adopted to process the coefficients which have been gotten. Finally, the signal after denoising is obtained by reconstructing the new wavelet coefficients. Experimental results indicate that, the SNR of signals can be increased to above 67dB, and simultaneously the RMSE can be lower than 0.01. From the perspective of these two methods of assessment, the proposed method is superior to other methods on the noise reduction. As a consequence, in the field of underwater acoustic signals denoising, it will have bright prospects.

articleTitle: An Identity Management Protocol For Multi-Identifier Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Since the birth of the Internet, there has been no identity management design at the network architecture level, leaving each service and platform to build its own identity system. As a new future network architecture, the Multi-Identifier Network considers identity design at the beginning of network design. It uses a blockchain-based Multi-Identifier System to manage identities. However, there is no unified design for the definition, application and revocation process of identity. In this paper, we propose a definition of identity format and design an operational logic for identity application, query and revocation. For the encoding method of the protocol, we compare the packet size and encoding speed between Protobuf and TLV methods.

articleTitle: A 69-to-89 GHz Compact Frequency Tripler Based on Self-Mixing Topology in 40nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, a low-power wideband frequency tripler is proposed for millimeter-wave frequency generation in 40nm CMOS. The circuit is composed of input driver, self-mixing tripler, and output driver. The self-mixing tripler consists of a push-push doubler and a single-balanced mixer connected by a transformer. The tripler can achieve both considerable power gain and large bandwidth with low power consumption. The post-layout simulation results show that the circuit covers a 3dB frequency range from 69 GHz to 89 GHz with a peak power gain of -8.4 dB, the fundamental suppression >22.5 dBc and second harmonic suppression >20.0 dBc. The design occupies 678 μm × 544 μm with total DC consumption of 24 mW where the core circuit consumes only 5.8 mW excluding input and output drivers.

articleTitle: Variable Cross-section Resonator Acoustic Levitation Ball Control
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In this paper, the HC-SR04 ultrasonic ranging module is used to send out sound waves with a fixed frequency. The shape of the resonator cross-section is changed by moving the piston up and down. In the experiment, the foam ball is used to find the levitated positions in the resonant cavity of different shapes and explore the maximum object that could be levitated at the position. Secondly, the experiment uses COMSOL to simulate the sound field, which agrees well with the experimental results. On this basis, the software is used to simulate the sound potential well of different resonant cavities to find the best position that can control the levitated object. Ultimately the simulation results are verified by experiment, realizing the control of the levitated object.

articleTitle: SAR ship recognition: dataset construction and long tail classification method
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Gaofen-3 (GF-3) is the first of China’s civil c-band fully polarized synthetic aperture radars (SAR), which is widely used for marine ship monitoring. However, at present, SAR ship recognition lacks sufficient datasets and the number of different ship categories is unbalanced, which causes the deep learning algorithms will not perform well on the ship datasets. In this study, to increase the number of samples of tail classes in the existing dataset, we construct a SAR ship classification dataset using GF-3 images and corresponding AIS data. In addition, due to the serious category imbalance problem in the SAR ship classification datasets, we propose a conditional probability-based multi-experts ensemble method. Experiments show that this method can achieve better performance than the existing long tail classification methods on the SAR ship classification dataset.

articleTitle: A Rehabilitation Training System for Hand-function Exoskeletons Based on the Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The rehabilitation effect was quantitatively evaluated and fed back in time in the rehabilitation training for stroke patients with limb movement disorders. The rehabilitation training system for hand-function exoskeletons based on the cloud platform promoted the efficient allocation of medical resources by breaking the Spatio-temporal limitations to a large extent. Hand-function rehabilitation training was integrated into games by combining the new somatosensory device LeapMotion with the Unity3D game engine. The rehabilitation training of patients distributed in different regions was tracked by the cloud platform technology based on the SSM and Shiro framework through the Internet. It provided timely feedback on the evaluation of the rehabilitation effect based on quantitative data. This system is of great significance in improving the rehabilitation training quality of hand-function patients, promoting the early recovery of patients, and reducing the burden on the family and society.

articleTitle: Pulmonary embolism image segmentation based on an U-net method with CBAM attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a common lung disease that has attracted increasing interest in recent years because of its high morbidity and mortality. Doctors manually segment pulmonary embolism from CTPA images to evaluate the patient’s risk level. However, this task is time consuming and laborious, and misdiagnosis can easily occur by using traditional methods because of the small size of pulmonary embolism and the category imbalance between foreground and background in the image. In this paper, we use the classical medical image segmentation model U-net for our pulmonary embolism segmentation scenario, and make the following improvements based on it for the mentioned problems. (1) We use the CBAM attention mechanism to make the U-net focus on the key areas in the image. (2) We use a hybrid loss function that consists of Dice loss and Focal loss to improve the category imbalance problem of pulmonary embolism target being too small in CTPA images. The final experiment results showed that our method was able to achieve 0.87027 on the mean IOU and 0.93063 on the Dice Score, thus proving the effectiveness of our method in segmenting pulmonary embolism.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Ed25519 coprocessor
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: The special elliptic curve-Ed25519 is a digital signature algorithm with high performance of signature and verification. When used for Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA), it can provides faster digital signatures than most of other curves. This paper presents a design of an ed25519 coprocessor. Field operations are based on Montgomery Multiplication, and inverse operation is based on extended Euclid algorithm. The coprocessor requires 40166 gates with 1Kbyte SRAM. It takes 0.62M clock cycles to complete an Eddsa scalar multiplication, which is more suitable for embedded systems and iot devices.

articleTitle: Computation and Simulation for Radiation of Antenna Patterns Mounted on Carbon-Fiber Composite Material
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of electromagnetic model subdivision and solution of carbon-fiber composite micro-structure, an equivalent model of composite material was established by homogenization method. Three kinds of common antennas in different frequency bands were selected, and the simulation calculation of antenna radiation pattern was carried out on three kinds of composite material installation platforms with different physical structures. The S parameters and radiation pattern of the antenna installed on different material platforms were compared and analyzed with the results of aluminum alloy installation platform as the reference.

articleTitle: Fixed grid-based radar sensing method for high dynamic railroad environment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Accurate detection of obstacles is an important condition for trains to be able to travel normally in complex environments and is also an important symbol reflecting the level of automation of rail lines. This paper proposes a fixed grid-based radar sensing method for a high dynamic railroad environment, firstly using a fixed grid-based millimeter wave radar denoising method to remove the flicker noise appearing in the millimeter wave radar sensing process; secondly classifying the effective targets into static targets and dynamic targets by clustering algorithm according to the obtained information of velocity, acceleration and position coordinates of the effective targets; finally screening the effective targets for warning level according to the pre-established radar target warning level classification table. The experiments show that the algorithm proposed in this paper is stable, can adapt to the high dynamic railroad environment, effectively removes the flash-out noise, and improves the accuracy of millimeter wave radar target recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Access Control and Authority Management of Industrial Internet Identification and Resolution System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: As the central nerve for the interconnection of the industrial Internet, industrial Internet identification and resolution system provides network services to national industrial manufacturing enterprises, and carries out network connection and data interaction with enterprise information system, factory internal identification system, factory identification acquisition equipment, etc. It involves a large amount of industrial data and a high level of security, once the service is restricted or attacked, it will have an important impact on the national economy and even pose a certain threat to national security, it is urgent to accelerate the construction of security prevention and control capacity of industrial Internet identification and resolution system. In this paper, we proposed the heterogeneous compatibility architecture of access control and authority management for industrial Internet identification and resolution system, realize unified access control and authority management of identification and resolution system in multi domain environment, it focuses on the analysis of identity authentication, authority management, access control mechanism and business process, the purpose is to prevent illegal user intrusion or damage caused by unauthorized access of legitimate users. The experimental results show that the proposed scheme can provide good access control and authority management capabilities for identification and resolution system, to ensure that nodes at all levels provide secure and reliable identification and resolution services, improve the comprehensive safety service capability.

articleTitle: Design of low power consumption marine environment monitoring system based on STM32F407
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: A mobile buoy-type low-power marine environment monitoring system is designed. The STM32F407 single-chip microcomputer is used as the control core of the ocean buoy, and the other two single-chip microcomputers are used to complete the data acquisition and forwarding between the various parts. Under the design requirements of rich and scalable interfaces, this embedded architecture greatly reduces power consumption. The buoy is innovatively divided into two parts: dry cabin and wet cabin in terms of mechanical structure. The corresponding entire observation system is divided into two main parts: the state perception system and the underwater detection system. Combined with the photovoltaic panel above the buoy, it controls the buoy. While the diameter is as low as 1.15 meters, the power generation efficiency is effectively guaranteed. The system has been optimized for low power consumption from the aspects of mechanical structure and software and hardware design. The system has achieved the expected goal through power consumption analysis and intersystem joint debugging test. It is a new system integration framework and is worthy of application and promotion.

articleTitle: Improved low complexity TPC decoding algorithm based on codeword reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Consiering the decoding of Turbo product code (TPC), we propose a modified Chase-Pyndiah (CP) decoding algorithm to reduce the complexity significantly. The proposed algorithm, denoted as Codeword reliability Chase-Pyndiah (CR-CP), simplifies the extrinsic information in CP algorithm by introducing the strategy of showing the codeword reliability. Furthermore, we dynamically adjust the number of the least unreliable bits and count the highly reliable codewords to decrease the computation complexity of extrinsic information. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm remarkably reduces the complexity compared to CP at the cost of negligible performance loss.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Preference Learning for Next POI Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation has become an important and challenging problem due to complex information and variety in user behavior patterns. Most of the prior studies utilized the RNN method to obtain their preference to various POIs. Recently, researchers integrate long- and short-term interests and achieve success. However, they fail to capture the influence of long-term preference on short-term preference. Besides, the granularity of the preference modeling is too coarse. To address the above limitations, we propose an end-to-end framework named Long- and Short-term Preference Learning with Transformer(LST), considering the user’s preference for various places at both long-term and short-term levels. Specifically, the multi-head self-attention mechanism in Transformer is utilized to extract long-term preference. To learn user’s short-term preference, we utilize spatial and temporal information of the POIs to model two different behavior patterns. In addition, our model incorporates long-term preference as background information into short-term preference to enhance the preference modeling ability. Results from extensive experiments performed on two Foursquare check-in datasets show that our model has advantages over the state-of-the-art baselines.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Integrated Information Management System for Dual Selection of NETM Tutors Based on SpringBoot
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the general increase of society’s requirements for education, more and more college students are joining the craze of NETM and universities keep putting forward the working concept of dual selection of NETM tutors. It is necessary to build a dual selection system based on SpringBoot framework and in line with agile development thinking. The existing information management system has problems such as low development efficiency, long iteration cycle and difficulty in changing requirements. Based on a comprehensive analysis of the requirements of the NETM tutor double-selection system, we created a work plan for NETM tutor double-selection based on MVVM design pattern, data interaction logic written by SpringBoot framework, data management using MySQL database and middleware such as MyBatisPlus and Redis, create a work plan for dual selection of NETM tutors and implemented the functions based on WeChat platform. The system unifies the login and registration behavior of users, unifies the front and back-end data exchange standards through RESTful style, and is equipped with the back-end management platform of ECharts, realizing the functions of automatic data collection, processing and analysis, and plays an active role in promoting the work related to postgraduate entrance examinations.

Author Keywords: Dual Selection System of NETM Tutors

articleTitle: Recipe Recommendation Based on Information Propagation of Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: During these years, the popularity of the Internet, services such as recipe sharing, food reviews and take-out have become increasingly common in life. In the scenario of using this kind of life service, people face the problem of information overload, so people are more inclined to accept system suggestions. Recipe recommendation is pushed to the forefront. A good recipe recommendation algorithm can greatly increase the happiness index of people's lives. However, existing research in the field of recipe recommendation generally ignores the relationship between recipe attributes (such as ignoring lamb souvlaki and Korean BBQ lamb chops have the same ingredients, craftsmanship, taste, etc.) resulting in incomplete learning of user and recipe representations, which leads to a situation of poor recommendation performance. To solve this problem, this paper presents a new recipe recommendation method based on the Information Propagation mechanism of Knowledge Graph (InPKG). Specifically, this method analyzes the higher-order structural features and relational characteristics of entities through the knowledge graph higher-order propagation properties, and uses a message aggregator to aggregate the obtained higher-order characteristics to obtain a richer representation of entities. The experimental results show that InPKG has advantages over existing classical recipe recommendation models and has good interpretability.

articleTitle: Image Encryption and Decryption Algorithm Based on Fractional Order Simplified Lorenz Chaotic System and DNA Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Traditional information encryption techniques lead to inefficient encryption and affect image formats when encrypting images. Therefore, how to ensure the secure storage and transmission of digital images has become a great challenge in the current image processing research. Chaos, a relatively typical nonlinear system at present, has many advantages and meets the design requirements of image encryption systems. In this paper, we take the basic theory of chaos as the entry point and combine it with DNA coding operation to investigate the image encryption method. A new color image encryption and decryption algorithm are designed based on the research of scholars. Mainly, DNA encoding is performed first, followed by a permutation operation to solve the chaotic sequence, generate a DNA matrix and perform operations using DNA operation rules; finally, DNA decoding is performed to obtain the ciphertext image. In addition, to decrypt the image, the pixel average of each component is hidden in the last pixel of each component matrix, which further improves the security of the algorithm. The simulation experimental results show that this method of encryption and decryption works well.

articleTitle: Multi-source data fusion for insider threat detection using residual networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: With the increased diversity of audit data sources and data heterogeneity within organizations, leveraging various data sources and fusing them is critical to improving insider threat detection. The data context between different sources is a part that is often overlooked by existing anomaly detection techniques. In this paper, we propose an insider threat detection method using residual convolutional neural networks for multisource data fusion to discover undetectable combinations of potential threats. The method first transforms tabular data into neighborhood-correlated feature maps, which allows for the contextual information fusion of the same layer by convolutional structure. Skip connections are then added between convolutional layers of different depths for multi-level feature fusion, which allows rich features at lower level to directly share weight information with highly aggregated features at higher levels. We simulated idealistic and realistic conditions for the experiments, and the results on the CERT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The insider detection rate is increased by 6% to 8% compared to 1D convolutional neural network models and by 8% to 14% compared to tree-based (Random Forest, XGBoost) models.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection for Patient-Family Binding E-health System Three-Factor Authentication Key Agreement
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: During the context of big data in Internet of Things, the E-health system provides patients with a flexible and convenient medical environment. However, the system still face various chanllenges, including how to protect the security of sensitive privacy information and serve patients better. In order to solve these security problems, scholars have put forward a lot of authentication schemes, but most of them still have security vulnerabilities. Moreover, most of schemes ignore the importance of family members in the E-health system. Family members participating in the system can not only concerned about the patient’s condition in real time, but also assist doctors in treatment and improve efficiency of treatment. To solve these problems, there is an urgent need for a secure, efficient and family friendly scheme for E-health system which also can protect the sensitive data. So we proposed a scheme for patient-family binding the E-health system with three-factor authentication. In our scheme, biometric extraction is used to protect sensitive data in the scheme to further enhance the security of the scheme. Beside, this scheme allow family members to participate in the scheme after binding with the patient for assist the medical server treat the patient. Since the process of authorizing family members in this scheme is performed by the patient, there is no additional burden on the server. In addition, the server authenticates family member and patient through different phase, which facilitates the server to distinguish between patient and family member. Finally, we analyze the security of our scheme through real-or-random model. The performance analysis proves that the patient-family member binding scheme is more secure and efficient for the E-health system.

articleTitle: An Alternative Curriculum Learning Approach with Macro Actions for Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: It is challenging to train deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents for tasks with sparse rewards, especially for those that require combining discrete actions with flexible control, e.g., the scoring task for robots in RoboCup soccer. Curriculum learning has been considered as a useful tool for DRL to accelerate the learning process by splitting the task into a sequence of progressively more difficult subtasks. In this paper, we propose an alternative curriculum learning approach that firstly makes the task easier by introducing macro actions, i.e., predefined procedures of actions for solving several subtasks. Once a DRL agent has been well trained for the easier task, the approach will disable one of the macro actions and continuously train the DRL agent for the refined task. The approach continues the process until all macro actions were disabled and a DRL agent were trained for the original task. Experiments on the Half Field Offense (HFO) platform for simulated RoboCup soccer show that the approach is effective and able to learn robust policies for challenging tasks, like HFO 2v2, which has not been reported to be solved by DRL as far as the knowledge of the authors. A demonstration video is available online at https://youtu.be/e6kunbAhhaY.

articleTitle: A Privacy-Preserving Mechanism Based on Privacy Situation Awareness for Information Sharing in OSNs
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (CECIT)
abstract: Various privacy-preserving mechanisms have been proposed to protect the privacy of individuals in online social networks, which have corresponding advantages in situations where they are primarily concerned. However, most of them applied static policies to all information audiences, resulting in the inability to satisfy the fine-grained requirements of information owners because audiences in the information propagation path are heterogeneous. To this end, we propose a novel privacy-preserving mechanism, in which the impact of each audience on the privacy situation of the information owner is evaluated.
